name: Taiyo Solar Works
description: A block theme for a regional solar installation company: a neutral grey ground, graphite and one small sun-ochre accent, Merriweather over Source Sans 3. Pages open on a half-and-half split of a roof photograph and a graphite gradient panel with an inset portrait; overlapping hairline circles carry case figures and white numeral cards show system size, estimated output and saving. Includes eleven inner pages (installations, a case study, residential, batteries and EV charging, commercial, how it works, maintenance, pricing, free roof assessment, about, contact), a journal, and sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without any plugin.
